why: The pilot, 2026-10-22: the main win con is 21 commander damage from EITHER commander, chosen by the board. Branched off finisher-v1 (which lost to the deck at olivers-table, 33/297 vs 45/299, by cutting the draw/discard/burn engine). Shabraz is primary: a flier with a counter per draw, Lae'zel and Yoshimaru add one each, Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard and the Archive double the draws. Brallin is secondary: Torbran +2 and Gratuitous Violence double his combat damage, with double strike and trample. Each line has a backup and a tutor (Idyllic Tutor, Stoneforge Mystic). Khorvath's Fury back; wheels down to four; one-sided sweepers for the go-wide table; red-capable rocks. Argued by the strategist (frame and one adversarial pass), card-scout (three passes), rules-question (Torbran and doubled damage count as Brallin's commander damage; Lae'zel makes a 7-card wheel 14 counters).
